scientific_role: first fresh real-system validation of calibration-only selective Layer-B promotion after known-truth qualification

source_identity.title: Massachusetts Wildlife Monitoring Project (2022 - 2024)
source_identity.license: CC0 / U.S. public domain marking as reported by USGS

selection_basis: multi-season camera-trap time series spanning approximately two years
public USGS release with explicit dictionary-mediated relational CSV architecture
public landing metadata states that media metadata and biological annotations/model outputs are separate CSV roles
sufficient temporal structure in principle for calibration, inner validation, and untouched outer heldout partitioning

allowed_operations: GET ScienceBase item JSON metadata for the frozen item id
inspect only file and child-item metadata fields such as names, ids, sizes, digests, content types and download URLs

forbidden_until_full_freeze: any species label, taxon annotation, detection count, capture-history value or model-output value

future_selective_promotion_invariants.selection_rule: promote Layer B only if the prospectively frozen augmented arm has strictly lower inner-validation macro log loss than baseline
future_selective_promotion_invariants.after_selection: freeze selected arm, refit according to prospectively frozen policy using calibration only, then score untouched outer heldout once

if_gate0_stop: do not repair this attempt after observing the live Gate0 result; select a new response-unconsumed candidate
